description: Defines the ControllerConnectivityTask class responsible for maintaining and monitoring connectivity to a controller within the prplMesh agent. Includes state management, timeout checks, and communication functions related to controller connectivity.

classes.name: ControllerConnectivityTask
classes.description: Manages and observes connectivity to the controller, handling timeouts, state transitions, and communication.

methods.name: ControllerConnectivityTask
methods.description: Constructor initializing the task with context and message transmitter.

methods.name: work
methods.description: Performs the main task operations, such as timeout checks and state management.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Handles events like connection, disconnection, and discovery.

methods.name: handle_cmdu
methods.description: Processes incoming messages related to controller communication.

methods.name: fsm_state_to_string
methods.description: Converts internal state enum to string for logging or debugging.

methods.name: check_controller_discovery_timeout
methods.description: Checks if controller discovery has timed out.

methods.name: check_controller_message_timeout
methods.description: Checks if controller message timeout has occurred.

methods.name: check_controller_response_timeout
methods.description: Checks if response timeout from controller has occurred.

methods.name: check_heartbeat_status
methods.description: Manages heartbeat message sending based on timeout conditions.

methods.name: send_hle_to_controller
methods.description: Sends a higher layer data message to verify connectivity.

methods.name: send_reconnect_to_backhaul_manager
methods.description: Instructs backhaul manager to attempt reconnection.

methods.name: init_task_configuration
methods.description: Reads configuration parameters to enable or disable the task.
